settings.name: Max Frame Rate
settings.value: VRR refresh minus 3 FPS when G-SYNC/VRR is confirmed, otherwise Off
settings.reason: Profile-specific caps avoid global FPS limits and keep VRR inside its range.

settings.name: Low Latency Mode
settings.value: Off when PUBG Reflex is available, On for non-Reflex DX11 paths
settings.reason: Prefer in-game NVIDIA Reflex and avoid driver Ultra as a default.

settings.name: Monitor Technology
settings.value: G-SYNC Compatible when VRR is confirmed, otherwise Use global setting
settings.reason: G-SYNC/VRR policy must be tied to display detection.

settings.name: Power management mode
settings.reason: Competitive per-game profile may trade power and heat for stable clocks.

settings.name: Preferred refresh rate
settings.reason: PUBG should use the detected high-refresh display mode.

settings.name: Shader Cache
settings.reason: Keep shader caching enabled and do not clear it as a default.

settings.name: Texture filtering - Quality
settings.reason: Competitive profile accepts visual tradeoff with explicit user opt-in.

settings.name: Vertical sync
settings.value: On for confirmed G-SYNC/VRR policy, otherwise Use the 3D application setting
settings.reason: VRR policy pairs NVIDIA V-SYNC with a below-refresh cap; non-VRR paths stay application-controlled.

policies.reflex: Prefer PUBG in-game NVIDIA Reflex + Boost; never stack driver Ultra Low Latency by default.
policies.gsyncVrr: Use a profile-specific cap below refresh when G-SYNC/VRR is confirmed.
policies.rebar: Resizable BAR is detect/recommend only; hidden per-game override bits are Lab-only and benchmark-gated.
